summary: Iteration 4 covers 4 new features (Export TXT, My Proxies/Sambung Server Asli, Paket Langganan, I18N + Theme toggle). Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass against preview URL — /api/plans returns all 4 plans (trial7/basic30/pro90/ultimate365), /api/subscription/activate {plan_id} extends expires_at by exactly plan days and sets tier=PREMIUM MEMBER (invalid plan -> 404, no token -> 401, history entry added), /api/proxies GET+POST+DELETE guarded (no token -> 401), validation for label/host/port working (400s), soft-delete removes from list and non-existent id -> 404, /api/hunt correctly prioritises owned proxies at top (owned=true SOCKS5 rows before generated). Fixed CRITICAL NameError bug in DELETE /api/proxies/{id} (server.py referenced undefined `oid_or_404` -> replaced with ObjectId(...) + InvalidId 404 guard). Frontend E2E on 390x844 web preview: login demo -> beranda; theme-toggle switches to light theme (screenshot confirms), lang-toggle switches PROFIL PELANGGAN <-> CUSTOMER PROFILE (Beranda<->Home tabs), preference persists across page reload; go-servers-card opens /servers, add-server modal + proxy-save-button creates 'E2E_TEST_srv' entry, delete removes it; go-plans-card opens /langganan showing 4 plan cards, activating basic30 returns to beranda and countdown jumps from ~30H to 330H (12J 25M 5D) confirming +30 days on top of prior active state; hunting for 8.8.8.8 returns 13 rows (owned 103.10.20.30:1080 SOCKS5 first with 'MILIK ANDA' badge), Salin Semua shows disalin toast, Ekspor TXT shows 'File proxy diekspor' toast (web clipboard fallback works); logout returns to /login. Regression: demo login + hunt + ip-info + history intact.

minor.issue: Deleting an already-soft-deleted proxy returns 200 again instead of 404, because the update_one matches the doc regardless of deleted_at. Cosmetic — soft-delete idempotency is arguably fine, but the intent seems to be 404 for gone rows. Consider filtering {'deleted_at': None} in the query.

ui_bugs.issue: On 390x844, proxy-save-button and proxy-cancel-button fall below the visible viewport when the modal opens with the keyboard-height container; Playwright reports 'Element is outside of the viewport' on direct click. Real users must scroll inside the modal to reach Save/Cancel. Same class of issue as the change-password modal in iteration 3. Wrap the modal body in a ScrollView / KeyboardAvoidingView + ScrollView so the action row is reachable without extra scrolling.

issues: 'File proxy diekspor' toast overlaps the target-IP input briefly after export (same cosmetic overlay as 'Salin Semua' toast noted last iteration).

react_native_issues.issue: Expo web console warns: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Non-blocking but should be migrated. Reference: styles across screens using shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius.

action_items: (FIXED by testing agent) NameError in DELETE /api/proxies/{id}: `oid_or_404` was undefined — replaced with inline ObjectId(...) + InvalidId 404 guard. Backend restarted; endpoint now works. Please double-check the fix aligns with your intended helper location.
(Nice to have) Wrap add-server / add-plan / change-password modal content in a ScrollView (or reduce vertical padding) so the primary action buttons are visible on ~390x844 without an extra swipe.
(Nice to have) Filter {'deleted_at': None} in DELETE /api/proxies/{id} so subsequent deletes of the same id return 404 for consistency.
(Nice to have) Migrate shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius StyleSheet entries to a single `boxShadow` string to clear Expo web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 561 referenced an undefined `oid_or_404` helper — direct call site would 500 on every DELETE /api/proxies/{id}. Fixed inline; consider adding a shared helper if you plan to reuse this ObjectId parse pattern.
PLANS list is defined inline in server.py; fine for now, but if you keep adding features consider extracting plans + hunt helpers into modules.
activate_subscription correctly normalises naive expires_at to UTC before comparing, matching the fix mentioned in the review note (verified: +90 days delta and +30 days compounding both work).

success_rate.backend: 100% (10/10 pytest for iteration 4 new features + regression; earlier 21/21 still valid)
success_rate.frontend: 100% for all six requested new-feature flows (theme toggle, lang toggle + persistence, servers CRUD, plans activation, hunt export + copy, logout regression)

rca_of_issue: DELETE /api/proxies/{id} NameError RCA: server.py referred to `oid_or_404(proxy_id, 'Proxy')` but the helper was never defined. Reproduction: create a proxy via POST /api/proxies then DELETE /api/proxies/<id> — server logs show `NameError: name 'oid_or_404' is not defined` and FastAPI returns 500. Mitigation applied: replaced the call with a local try/except ObjectId(...) + InvalidId -> HTTPException(404) block, matching how the rest of the file handles user._id via ObjectId(user.id). Verified by pytest test_create_and_list_and_soft_delete (200 create -> 200 delete) and 404 for an arbitrary well-formed ObjectId.
